description: Remember a spelling only when the user asks. Prefer learn_correction for a correction to a misheard name. Writes one term, globally by default or to .lexicon.yaml with scope: 'project'. Existing terms keep their canonical spelling and gain aliases; other terms are untouched. An untrusted project file stays untrusted: relay `trusted: false` and `nextStep`; terms apply after the user runs `lexicon trust` (or `npx @ashlr/lexicon trust`). Omitted aliases auto-generate likely STT misspellings for new terms only (possibly none); show them for approval or ask for aliases when none are found. Explicit `aliases: []` generates none. On existing terms, omitted aliases add none, so other fields can be updated alone. Alias collisions return `conflicts` (each { canonical, scope, as, spelling }) and a `note` with the remove_term call; conflicting terms are untouched. Invalid fields or exceeded argument caps are errors naming the field; nothing is written.

aliases.description: Spellings STT actually produces for this term, each at most 80 characters; a term holds at most 64; a blank one is an error and nothing is written. Omit to auto-suggest (new terms only; often none are found). An explicit [] adds none and generates none.

canonical.description: The correct spelling, exactly as the user wants it written; must not be blank. At most 80 characters once surrounding whitespace is trimmed (the lexicon file schema's cap, also enforced by the CLI); a longer one is refused and nothing is written.

context.description: Words that must also appear in the text for this term to apply, e.g. ["phantom"] for a Lucas -> locus alias that only fires in fleet talk; each at most 80 characters, at most 64 per term; a blank one is an error and nothing is written.

never.description: Ordinary words that must never be rewritten to this term even if they sound alike, e.g. ["sauce"] for SaaS; each at most 80 characters, at most 64 per term; a blank one is an error and nothing is written.

notes.description: Free text shown to agents, e.g. "my company; never write Ashlar": one line, at most 200 characters.

phonetic.description: Pronunciation hint, e.g. "ASH-ler": one line, at most 200 characters.

name: add_term
title: Add a lexicon term
